title: Meter readings delay and corrupt invoices
source_story: User-provided fictional owner stories in this conversation; opening narrative below is a faithful condensed adaptation, not a verbatim transcript.
business_context: Managed print provider; approximately 420 devices with usage-based agreements.
owner_narrative: Our administrator collects meter photos, remote readings and technician notes. Contracts have different color and monochrome allowances; some pool machines. A replacement device’s opening reading was attached to the old machine, producing a disputed bill.

diagnostic_interview.question: Can counters be linked to device identity?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: Photos often omit the serial, and filenames identify only the customer.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Device linkage is necessary before arithmetic.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: If identity and readings are correct but a tariff formula is wrong, repair the calculation; do not demand additional photographs.

diagnostic_interview.question: What happens at replacement?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: We do not consistently capture the old closing and new opening readings.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: Are special allowances structured?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: Some exist only in emails and the administrator’s memory.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Correct extraction cannot fix missing commercial rules.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

diagnostic_interview.question: Can a counter decrease legitimately?
diagnostic_interview.synthetic_answer: A replacement or reset can cause it, but ordinary readings should not.
diagnostic_interview.diagnostic_value: Detect exceptions rather than forcing a plausible value.
diagnostic_interview.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

evidence.description: A simulated replacement worksheet lacks a closing reading.
A simulated photo links to the wrong serial.
A simulated agreement contains a pooled allowance.

diagnoses.hypothesis: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.
diagnoses.counterhypothesis: If identity and readings are correct but a tariff formula is wrong, repair the calculation; do not demand additional photographs.
diagnoses.confidence_policy: Qualitative case-world support only; requires fresh customer evidence before reuse.

interventions.process_first: Normalize reviewed contract terms; record installation and removal readings; hold unresolved segments for accounts review.
interventions.deterministic_and_assisted_automation: Extract reading drafts with image references; validate chronology and counters; calculate usage with deterministic decimal rules and produce an exception queue.
interventions.rejected_default: Do not replace the whole service platform or deploy autonomous agents solely because the owner reports inefficiency.
interventions.selection_basis: Choose the least complex intervention addressing the supported handoff failure; compare added administration and integration burden.

requirements.statement: Negative deltas block ordinary billing unless an approved reset or replacement segment explains them.
requirements.rationale: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.

requirements.statement: Pool allowance is applied once per defined group and period.
requirements.rationale: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.

requirements.statement: OCR confidence never authorizes invoice sending.
requirements.rationale: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.

requirements.statement: Corrected readings retain the original and reason.
requirements.rationale: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.

acceptance_tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Old and new devices are calculated as distinct segments.
A repeated image hash raises a duplicate warning.
A pooled allowance is not subtracted once per device.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Meter billing and invoicing are explicitly outside the current ticket module; implement separately.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.

evaluation.primary_metric_definition: Invoices requiring correction / invoices issued; separately measure days from period close to review-ready billing.
measurement_cautions: Use a stable denominator and comparable operating periods.
Record missingness and changed case mix.
Do not infer staff reductions from reclaimed task minutes.

implementation.baseline: Collect at least one representative operating cycle before rollout; for monthly billing or maintenance include the relevant full cycle. Extend sampling when volumes or seasonality make the sample unrepresentative.
implementation.scope: Start with one consenting customer group and the staff who own its handoffs; include a normal case and each listed exception.
sequence: Reconcile identities and existing obligations with the process owner.
Run the proposed rules in shadow mode; record disagreements and missed exceptions.
Approve a bounded live pilot only after requirements and exceptions have named owners.
Review outcome metrics, added administrative work and failure logs before expanding.
implementation.simulated_resolution: In this fictional case, MILO introduced the process change: Normalize reviewed contract terms; record installation and removal readings; hold unresolved segments for accounts review. The team adopted the proposed workflow for the pilot scope. Routine coordination became explicit; unresolved exceptions continued to require a person.
implementation.simulated_lesson: If identity and readings are correct but a tariff formula is wrong, repair the calculation; do not demand additional photographs.
implementation.rollback: Pause automated writes and notifications, retain the event log, export outstanding work and return to a named manual coordinator. Reconcile queued events before resuming to avoid duplicate actions.
implementation.go_no_go: Process owner reviews coverage of acceptance cases, unresolved critical failures, metric direction and staff workload. No fixed performance threshold is claimed without customer agreement.

open_questions: Proration, taxes, minimum charges, resets and rounding rules must come from the customer’s approved terms.

transfer_rules.applicable_when: Reading provenance and effective-dated device/contract mapping are missing from billing preparation.
transfer_rules.do_not_assume: If identity and readings are correct but a tariff formula is wrong, repair the calculation; do not demand additional photographs.
